name: psmux
title: psmux — Native Windows tmux in Rust
tagline: Born in PowerShell. Made in Rust. The real tmux for Windows.
description_zh: 原生 Windows 终端复用器，Rust 编写，ConPTY 直连，兼容 tmux 命令与配置，无需 WSL。
description_en: Native Windows terminal multiplexer. Born in PowerShell, made in Rust. Uses ConPTY directly, speaks tmux command language, reads .tmux.conf, supports tmux themes. No WSL, Cygwin, or MSYS2.
highlights: 83 tmux commands + 140+ format variables + 53 vim copy-mode keys
Full .tmux.conf compatibility — drop in your existing config
Claude Code agent teams first-class integration

install.Scoop: scoop bucket add psmux https://github.com/psmux/scoop-psmux && scoop install psmux
